name: 36-embed-openrouter-media
description: embedOpenRouterMedia (prompt-converters.js:1336-1370) with the options object **omitted**, so the destructuring default `{audio: true, video: true}` applies and nothing can be skipped by a false flag. The audio part is a data URL: its header is matched by `/data:([^;]+)/` for the mime type, `audio/wav` is the one formatMap hit, and the content type becomes `input_audio` while `audio_url` is deleted. A second audio part uses a mime type the formatMap does not know, which falls back to 'mp3'. The non-data audio URL is left completely alone, the third part is a non-data video URL (the video branch is an assignment to a value it already has), and a message whose `content` is a string is skipped by the array guard at the top of the loop.
